# Mirabel Cotton

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Mirabel Cotton is described as being remarkably sunburned. She also exhibits a particularly noisy and reckless demeanor.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is noted for her boisterous and uninhibited demeanor. She is described as being particularly noisy, sunburned, and reckless, drawing comparisons to a boy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## Traits

- noisy (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

Mirabel Cotton gained a reputation for telling frightening ghost stories that upset local children like [Dora](../character/dora.md). She later spent a Sunday playing and going fishing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and the rest of the Cotton children after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) snuck away from [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +127 more_

## Relationships

### [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

Mirabel Cotton and [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) are brother and sister. In Volume 3, they spend time playing together alongside other neighborhood children like [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) drags his sister away from [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons).
